explanation: Q1 groups by YEAR and COURSE_ID, counting instructors per course-year pair. Q2 groups only by YEAR, counting all instructors across all courses in that year. When multiple courses in the same year each have more than 4 instructors, Q1 sums the year for each qualifying course, while Q2 sums it once per year.
counterexample_dsp: Two courses in year 2020 each taught by 5 instructors. Q1 returns 4040 (2020 + 2020), Q2 returns 2020.
